mainEntity.name: How can a kitchen peninsula improve my kitchen's functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen peninsula can significantly enhance functionality by providing additional counter space for meal preparation, extra seating for casual dining, or a dedicated area for small appliances. It can also help define kitchen zones, improving workflow and organization. When planning, consider how you intend to use the peninsula most often; this will guide decisions on size, height, and whether to integrate features like a sink or cooktop.
